entryModels.field-boss: single: no difficulty; keep raw phases/map provenance separate from selectable difficulty
entryModels.entry-boss: difficulty-select: ordinary difficulty family; per-boss availability is not assumed
entryModels.high-raid-boss: level-select: preserve BaseLevel/MinLevel; do not convert to Easy/Normal/Hard presets
entryModels.guild-raid-boss: level-select: current combat level from remaining HP gauges, not ordinary difficulty or HighRaid scaling

highRaidLevelEvidence: HighRaidRoomData.get_MobDifficultyLevel returns 0 while get_AreaLevel reads a separate level; UIHighRaidEnterManager changes a selected numeric level. Runtime range is not materialized.

high-raid-boss.rule: HighRaidBossMaster fieldId+roomId+monsterUuid; primary monsterId/UUID must match the map master

field-boss.rule: Boss=4, exact MobPopPoint.monsterDatabaseID and ancestor mmo_{master.roomId}

entry-boss.rule: Boss=4 and explicit BossMenu event entry targets the exact fieldId+roomId

unresolved.rule: No positive source route; never infer from absence or monster name

guild-raid-boss.rule: Reviewed guild-raid-bosses.json main anchors with exact field/room/UUID/model/element, and explicit same-identity mode references; live field/MobList is server-owned.

bossMenu.header: byte scriptVersion, int16 eventCount, int32 absoluteOffsets[eventCount]
bossMenu.scope: Event roots plus reviewed scriptVersion16 ProgressQuest/Check control-flow edges; stop at unknown opcodes and dynamic ReadInt operands; never scan payload bytes
bossMenu.targetPrefix: version<14: int16 fieldId; version14: int32 fieldId; version>=15: byte commandVersion, byte unusedRaw, int32 fieldId; then byte roomId
bossMenu.invalidOffsets: Retain unusable event slots separately; never use them as classification evidence

fieldPopEvidence.serialized: Exact MobPopPoint reference and mmo room ancestry, not merely a room existing on the map
fieldPopEvidence.boundary: Static source-route classification. Scene naming correspondence is supported by serialized hierarchy and native Mmo contracts; active runtime room selection was not observed.

limitations: One game UUID can have multiple classifications in different maps/variants.
HighRaid is an explicit game subsystem; do not label every event or High Difficulty name as HighRaid.
Entry classification does not authorize ordinary difficulty multipliers for every battle subclass.
Boss phases, parts, final battle stats and currently available server events remain separate.
